title: grangea gossypina
intro: Grangea gossypina, commonly known as Grangea maderaspatana or Wild Jute, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Grangea gossypina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
